scope: conditional nodal interpolation-error control for prescribed C2 forcing; not general FDE or roundoff certification
design_basis: global positive-kernel bound M/8 * sum(h_j^2 * integral_panel kernel/Gamma(alpha)); all old panels retained
curvature_bounds: 0 for affine; 2 for quadratic/cubic; 4 for sin(2t); [0,2] for [1+2t,t^2]
references: analytic polynomial integrals and independent weighted SciPy quadrature for sin(2t), all on actual accepted nodes
gate: complete unique matrix; finite completed outputs; independently reconstructed history envelope; true error enclosed with precision-specific roundoff slack; observed reference-scaled error <=1 for these selected tolerances
stopping_rule: one full sweep per precision; preserve every failure and do not adjust configurations to pass
